summary: Round-1 QA of the live 20 Hour Weeks place (24960 parts). Automated walkthrough and blueprint_check currently PASS (0 FAIL lines) — those checkers are weak relative to photos. A player can enter at (0,0,0), walk the west glass hall (ping-pong/vending), climb the two-flight main stair to L2 (HRP y=22.27), walk the overlook with the volleyball gym on the LEFT, and reach the racquetball door. Zone tags (205) and Lighting infinite-yield are fixed this session. Remaining ship-blockers: gym floor is cream tiles not glossy maple; interiors are too dark and empty; entrance stairs sit 41 ft west of the door as a tiled plaza; canopy is a high rectangular slab not a thin wedge; roads/parking are not on lidar and lots have no real stalls; trees are WedgeParts; Play memory is 4.7 GB. Do not ship until maple, lighting, entrance stair/canopy, roads/parking, and trees match the photos.
